    ✊ Krowretism — The Church of Krowretism¶

    "No crown, no church, no master but freedom."

    Krowretism — the Church of Krowretism — is the radical freedom-faith of the Human Republic of Northeastern Merratodoni and its sister region the Crab Union.

    The faithful believe the real human god is Krowret, the inner man — that men descend from the gods directly — and that the monotheistic Eris religion is false. They believe humans were deceived by the demon Eris and her followers — that Eris is not a goddess but a demon, her church a cage. They believe they must purify the world from Eris forever and destroy her church.

    The Human Republic — Exodus and Superpower¶

    Human Republic of Northeastern Merratodoni — the church's heartland — are refugees from the Erisdar continent and the Erisian Church.

    • ~100 BGD — they started leaving Erisdar approximately 100 years Before Great Divergence — the first dissidents to reject Eris.
    • They settled in Merratodoni and ever since have been building a superpower on the continent — democratic, expansionist, and fiercely anti-Erisian.
    • As of 597 AGD, they are in the process of unifying with the Purple Coast — although they aren't a single entity yet. Negotiations, councils, and joint administration are underway.
    • They plan to expand westwards: the middle of Merratodoni is mostly unpopulated and they are colonizing it — a continental manifest destiny.

    The Republic is similar to the United States of America of Old Earth — a frontier democracy built by refugees, obsessed with absolute freedom, industrial and militant, convinced of its mission to purify the world.

    The Crab Union — Sister Faith¶

    The Crab Union (Crab Archipelago) is a majority human region that follows Krowretism — but they also have Seamen among their population. The Crab Union's Krowretists are culturally close to the Human Republic — both see themselves as the free humans who escaped Eris.

    Tenets¶

    • Krowret, the Inner Man — the real human god is Krowret, the inner man. Not an outer tyrant, but the divine spark inside every human. To worship Krowret is to awaken what is already within.
    • Men Descend from Gods Directly — humans are not fallen, not made from dust, but direct descendants of the gods. The blood of the gods runs in human veins — a literal lineage, not a metaphor. Krowretism is therefore a divine anthropology: to be human is to be god-kin.
    • The Monotheistic Eris Religion is False — the Erisian Church's claim that Eris is the one true god is a lie. Eris-monotheism is false prophecy, a demon's cage to cut humans off from Krowret within. Krowret is the true monotheism — the inner god.
    • Absolute Freedom — the highest divine value. No master, no hierarchy, no church between human and destiny. Law exists to protect freedom, not to constrain it.
    • Eris as Demon — Eris is not a goddess but a demon who deceived humanity. Her church is a demon cult. Every Erisian temple is a profanation.
    • Purification — the world must be purified from Eris forever and her church destroyed. This is not metaphor — Krowretists are the main sponsors of the Ironcloak, the rebel order that fights the Shadows and the Church.
    • The Sponsors of the Ironcloak — the Human Republic funds, arms, and shelters the Ironcloak — the only nation to do so openly.

    Practices¶

    • Democratic liturgy — sermons are debates, prayers are votes.
    • Iconoclasm — Erisian icons are destroyed on sight.
    • Oath of Freedom — every citizen swears to defend absolute freedom, even against their own government.

    Connections¶

    • Nations: Human Republic of Northeastern Merratodoni (heartland), Crab Union (Crab Archipelago)
    • Sponsor: Ironcloak
    • Enemy: Erisian Church, Eris (as demon)
    • Region: Merratodoni (northeast), Crab Archipelago
    • Age: Exodus ~100 BGD → superpower by 597 AGD, unifying with Purple Coast, colonizing middle Merratodoni westwards
